title: A front face wide shot shows a man in a plaid shirt and jeans sits on a stool…
content: A front face wide shot shows a man in a plaid shirt and jeans sits on a stool in a cluttered art studio, painting on a canvas on an easel. The studio is filled with art supplies, including tubes of paint on the floor, brushes in jars, and several other canvases leaning against the walls. A large window with sheer curtains lets in natural light, illuminating the scene. The floor is stained with paint splatters, adding to the authentic, lived-in feel of the artist's workspace. golden hour sunlight

Una toma amplia frontal muestra a un hombre con camisa de cuadros y jeans sentado en un taburete en un estudio de arte desordenado, pintando sobre un lienzo en un caballete. El estudio está lleno de materiales de arte, incluidos tubos de pintura en el suelo, pinceles en frascos y varios otros lienzos apoyados contra las paredes. Una gran ventana con cortinas translúcidas deja entrar la luz natural, iluminando la escena. El suelo está manchado con salpicaduras de pintura, lo que añade una sensación auténtica y vivida al espacio de trabajo del artista. luz de la hora dorada

Para crear una cámara que se mueva hacia abajo entre una sección transversal de cada piso, la base de tu prompt debe incluir lo siguiente: "A cinematic wide shot moves continuously downward through a cross-section of an apartment building, each floor slab passing into view as the camera descends, exposed like a dollhouse with the front wall removed."

A cinematic wide shot moves continuously downward through a cross-section of an apartment building, each floor slab passing into view as the camera descends, exposed like a dollhouse with the front wall removed. Warm, low afternoon light spills into every room at the same low angle, casting long shadows and a golden cast across every surface, tying every floor to the same moment in time, though each room belongs to a completely different life. 

The shot opens on a wide shot of a paint-splattered studio, where a man sits on a stool before an easel, palett brush poised mid-stroke. The only sound is the faint bristle-drag of the brush against canvas and floorboards under his shifting weight. 

The camera drifts down past the concrete floor slab into a wide shot of the next apartment, where a family is gathered around a dining table, plates half-finished, exchanging warm glances and easy laughter without words, the soft clink of cutlery and quiet murmurs of contentment filling the room, afternoon sun cutting across the tablecloth. 

Descending again, the camera passes into a wide shot of a cluttered workshop where an Indian man is fixing a seventies-styled humanoid robot, its chrome-and-orange chassis scattered with exposed wiring and analog dials. He tightens a final connection with a screwdriver, and the robot's eyes flicker, then glow steady, its head turning toward him with a soft servo whir. He steps back, delighted, letting out a surprised laugh as the robot flexes its fingers for the first time, afternoon light catching the polished chrome in the same low, warm angle as the floor above. 

The camera drifts down past the concrete floor slab into a wide shot of a teenager's bedroom, where two young women dance loosely to music playing from a boombox propped on the dresser, laughing between missteps, the beat filling the room, sunlight cutting through half-closed blinds and striping the floor. 

Descending again, the camera passes into a wide shot into a small indoor garden in a living room, where an elderly Korean couple kneel side by side among rows of potted herbs and vegetables, working the soil with small trowels, exchanging a quiet glance and a small smile between them, the soft scrape of tools against clay pots the only sound, afternoon light warming the leaves and their weathered hands. 

[SOUND] Strictly only naturally occurring sound and foley, Absolutely no music, no score, no soundtrack, no ambient musical tones at any point. No dialogue at any point. Diegetic sound only.
